# List of plasma physics software

simulation image]]
This is a list of plasma physics software, including programs and tools used for simulating, modeling, and analyzing plasma behavior, magnetohydrodynamics (MHD), and related phenomena. These software packages are used in research, fusion power studies, and plasma engineering.
Simulation and modeling
{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Software, tool
! Note, reference
! License
|-
| BOUT++
| 3D plasma fluid simulation code used for edge-localized mode (ELM) and turbulence studies in tokamaks.
|
|-
| FLASH
| Adaptive mesh refinement code for simulating compressible plasmas and astrophysical flows.
|
|-
| Gkeyll
| Continuum kinetic simulation framework for plasma physics and fusion applications. Supports gyrokinetic, Vlasov, and fluid models.
|
|}
Particle-in-cell (PIC) codes
{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Software, tool
! Note, reference
! License
|-
| EPOCH
| PIC code for high-intensity laser-plasma interactions.
|
|-
| LSP
| Particle-in-cell and hybrid plasma simulation code.
|
|-
| Magic
| PIC software used for plasma simulations
|
|-
| OSIRIS
| Fully relativistic, electromagnetic PIC code for plasma and laser-plasma simulations.
|
|-
| Starfish
| Particle-in-cell plasma simulation code.
|
|-
| VPIC
| Vector Particle-In-Cell code designed for large-scale plasma simulations on supercomputers
|
|-
| VSim
| Particle-in-cell and electromagnetic plasma simulation software.
|
|}

{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Software, tool
! Note, reference

| CFD-ACE+
| Multiphysics computational software including plasma simulations.
|
|-
| COMSOL
| General multiphysics simulation platform with plasma modules.
|
|-
| Quantemol-VT
| Commercial plasma modeling software for molecular and quantum plasma simulations.
|
|-
| STAR-CCM+
| Multiphysics simulation platform including plasma modeling modules.
|
|-
| USim
| Commercial plasma and multiphysics modeling software
|
|-
| VizGlow
| Commercial software for modeling thermal plasmas and plasma-material interactions.
|
|-
| VizSpark

|
|}
Magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) software
{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Software, tool
! Note, reference
! License
|-
| ATHENA++
| High-order Godunov code for astrophysical MHD simulations.
|
|-
| M3D-C1
| Extended MHD code for simulating tokamak plasmas, including stability and transport analysis.
|
|-
| NIMROD
| Nonlinear MHD code for modeling magnetically confined plasmas, including tokamak disruptions.
|
|-
| EOF-Library
| Energy-conserving orbit-following library for kinetic plasma simulations, designed for coupling energetic particle dynamics to MHD and hybrid models.
|
|-
| PLUTO
| Modular code for astrophysical and laboratory plasma simulations with MHD, relativistic, and multi-fluid capabilities.
|
|-
| VAC (Versatile Advection Code)
| General-purpose MHD code for astrophysics and laboratory plasmas.
|
|}
